amendments.description: Prompt requests at least six o characters; original grading metadata erroneously required fewer than six.

Seven-dice exact arithmetic has no local passes and still failed Nemotron Super with a 12,288-token thinking allowance. Poor discrimination in the current tool-free 4,096-token core battery. Valid question retained for optional tool-assisted or longer-budget work; not claimed impossible.
